_qa_note: tools/check.py thresholds (report only; defaults in QA there). render: lufs +/- lufs_tol = integrated loudness target, true_peak_db = ceiling; delivery = what the final file must be, e.g. {"codec": "prores", "profile": "HQ", "size": [3840, 2160], "fps": 29.97} (empty = size from frame, fps from fps, codec not checked); black_s = shortest black counted (a black tail up to black_end_ok_s is a fade-out); freeze_s = shortest frozen picture counted. decup: min_clip_frames = an enabled clip shorter than this is a flash; repeat_min_words = the same n words twice in a row; word_cut_p = a word heard across a join or at a loud cut below this Whisper confidence counts as chopped. frames: safe_title = centred fraction of the frame text must stay inside; contrast_min / contrast_large = WCAG ratio of text vs what is around it (large = glyph >= large_text_h of the frame height); offpalette_min_area = a flat area in a colour not in colors (nor a mix / tint / shade) counts from this fraction of the frame.
_notes: NEUTRAL PLACEHOLDERS - replace every value for the client (novo-cliente skill) and delete _template. Prose rules live in STYLE.md. 'ps' = PostScript names tried in order in After Effects (first installed wins). decup.roles = file-name patterns per camera; decup.settle = how far the voice must decay before a cut point (fraction of the speech range above the floor; null = off); decup.inner_gap_s = shortest pause removed inside a sentence; study_roles = extra patterns for edit_study (generated b-roll, logo sting). decup.transcribe: chunks (split at silences >= chunk_silence_s, each chunk transcribed alone, word times aligned to the voice) | whole. Second pass (decup.py polish): esticada_s = a word Whisper stretched past this hides a hesitation, its start is cut (null = off); muletas = crutch words/phrases proposed when they open a breath group (pause >= muleta_pausa_s) or dangle at its end (Claude decides); narra_clique = regexes (accent-less text) of short lines that only narrate a click, marked REVER. sequence_size = Premiere sequence [w, h] (e.g. [3840, 2160] for 4K); screen_video_enabled = screen recording video on in the XML (audio always off); screen_scale fit | fill. camera_switch numbers come from tools/edit_study.py on the editor's final cut. motion.intensity: 1 = calm baseline, 1.5 = bolder. apoio = imagens-apoio skill: source order (each skipped when its key is missing), client footage folders relative to the client folder, prefer video|photo, spacing between moments, clip length range, search language for Pixabay, regiao = the client's country added to the queries of moments marked regional (places, money, government, documents; regional_padrao true = every moment). fonts.<role>.file = font file for the code path (relative to the client folder, e.g. brand/fonts/X.ttf; empty = the installed family). modo_apresentador = where the presenter is: sobre (motion over the talking head, the default), bolha (presenter in a round bubble inside the motion), tela_dividida (split screen), so_voz (no presenter: full motion under the voice). caminho_padrao = default path of a scene (after | codigo | ia; the storyboard can change it per scene). ritmo: calmo (entrada_s 0.8, novo_a_cada_s 3, viagem_s 0.6) or dinamico (0.45 / 1.5 / 0.45); entrada_s = length of one entrance, novo_a_cada_s = longest gap without something new on screen, viagem_s = camera travel between blocks, fim_s = closing pull-out. sfx = sound of the motion (tools/sfx.py): intensidade auto (from motion.intensity: < 1.15 subtil, < 1.4 medio, else forte) | subtil | medio | forte (a brief that asks for simple, never exaggerated motion = subtil); excluir = more library folders to leave out (e.g. '01_Transicoes/Risers'); incluir = switch on what is off by default (themes 'horror', 'armas', or a folder such as '15_Memes_Cartoon_Famosos'); ganho_db = level offset of every cue; musica = a licensed bed file (relative to the episode or absolute), 20 dB under the voice. grade = the fixed layout grid every block shares: margem (fraction of the frame's short side), alinhamento (esquerda | centro), hierarquia (order of a block, top to bottom), sublinhado (accent bar under the title), etiqueta_maiusculas.
